title: Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Mr. Kerman's hash codes

infobox.usage: Allows access to the Terminal location a single time.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Mr. Kerman's hash codes (RFID Mr.K) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An RFID keycard reprogrammed using hash codes from Mr. Kerman. Grants access to the port Terminal. At least, it should.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
- This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket if the player sided with Mr. Kerman.
